entities.summary: The 1804 Mtiuleti rebellion was a conflict in Mtiuleti region of the former Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti, at that time part of the Georgia Governorate of the Russian Empire. It was the first major Georgian rebellion directed against the Russian administration.
